description:
We are COSMORA, a team of passionate tech enthusiasts excited about space exploration, innovation, and problem-solving. We enjoy building creative solutions using technology, AI, and data-driven approaches. Our goal is to turn challenging ideas into meaningful projects while learning and collaborating along the way.

We welcome members interested in AI/ML, web development, data analysis, UI/UX design, scientific research, and creative problem-solving.
summary:
FLAMEGUARD AI is an interactive, AI-powered space fire safety intelligence platform designed to support safer human exploration of the Moon and beyond.

Fire behaves differently in microgravity, where the absence of natural buoyancy changes flame behaviour, heat transfer and combustion patterns. These challenges become even more critical in spacecraft and future lunar habitats with oxygen-enriched atmospheres.

Our solution brings NASA's Physical Sciences Informatics (PSI) combustion research into an interactive mission-control dashboard. It features a Mission Flammability Ranker, atmospheric condition visualisations, a searchable experiment matrix, historical space-fire incident analysis and an AI-powered copilot that helps users explore and compare combustion investigations.

By connecting experimental research with future mission scenarios, FLAMEGUARD AI helps researchers, engineers and space enthusiasts better understand potential fire hazards, explore experimental evidence and identify important safety considerations for future crewed space missions.
details:
COSMORA is an AI-powered microgravity fire-safety and habitat risk intelligence platform built for NASA’s Flame in Freefall challenge. In microgravity (0g), natural buoyancy disappears—turning flickering teardrop flames into slow, spherical "cool flames" driven purely by diffusion and cabin airflow. Meanwhile, planned Artemis lunar habitats and pressurized rovers will operate at >= 30% O2 and <= 10.2 psi, drastically increasing ignition and flammability hazards.

How It Works & Key Features:

- Mission Preset Ranker: Evaluates and ranks 12 core NASA Physical Sciences Informatics (PSI) combustion investigations (including BASS, BASS-II, Saffire-I–III, ACME CFI-G, FLEX, SAME, and SAME-R) across mission profiles such as Lunar Base (30% O2), ISS (21% O2), and EVA Spacesuit (100% O2).

- Interactive Atmosphere Simulator: Plots exploration environments on an O2% vs. Pressure (PSI) risk matrix, letting engineers test custom gas mixtures and generate live AI ignition and suppression briefings.

- Side-by-Side Experiment Matrix & AI Copilot: Compares experimental parameters across studies and runs a grounded RAG assistant powered by Groq (Llama-3.3-70B) that cites exact PSI investigation IDs and enforces transparent partial-gravity (1/6g) scientific guardrails ahead of upcoming NASA LUCI and FM2 lunar data.

Tech Stack & Impact:

Built with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Recharts, and Groq SDK (Llama-3.3-70B). Beyond protecting Artemis lunar habitats and spacecraft crews, PyroScope-0g maps microgravity smoke, droplet, and fabric findings directly to NASA terrestrial firefighting spinoffs—including pre-combustion early-warning smoke detectors, lighter composite air tanks, and thermal-protective firefighter turnout gear.
